title: Valid Palindrome II
summary: Determine if a string can become a palindrome by removing at most one character.
statement: Determine if a string can become a palindrome by removing at most one character.
constraints: Return true when s is already a palindrome or can become one by deleting exactly one optional character.
hints: Before the first mismatch, no deletion choice matters.
At the first mismatch, test the two possible one-character skips.
Walk inward; on mismatch check s[left+1:right] and s[left:right-1].
Any valid solution must delete one of the two mismatching boundary characters, so the two checks are exhaustive.
editorial: Any valid solution must delete one of the two mismatching boundary characters, so the two checks are exhaustive.
